answer: Sybil resistance works when joining burns scarce compute and locked stake that only unlocks after peers attest real graded work across staggered windows. A clone flood creates a cost ripple that empties the attacker before any emission pays out. At dawn of each epoch, unpaid bonds burn and unpaid seats expire. Bind the bond receipt to a juniper-hashed work transcript so one proof cannot be copied onto many identities without matching the full attestation trail.
